completedAt.description: Completion instant in UTC RFC 3339 form with Z, retaining fractional precision; null or absence is preserved.

percentComplete.description: Completion percentage; 100 indicates completed. Null or absence is preserved.

assigneePriority.description: Opaque ordering hint for the assignee's task list, when supplied.

appliedCategoryIds.description: Category property names whose appliedCategories values are true, when supplied; not category display labels.

items.description: An applied category property name.

conversationThreadId.description: Associated group conversation-thread ID, if supplied.

items.description: A Planner task with compact task properties.
Tasks in this provider page, in provider order; an empty array is valid.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for another page; omitted when no next link exists.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_listuse.description: One page of Planner tasks and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this for on-demand browsing of a user's tasks; use `get-user-task` for a known task and `get-user-task-details` for its description, checklist, and links. Supply a directory user ID. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same user and query settings. The limit defaults to 50 and ranges from 1 to 100.

functions.name: move-task
functions.description: Move an existing task into another bucket in the same plan, retaining its task identity and other task content.

taskId.description: Opaque ID of the task being moved.

bucketId.description: Case-sensitive destination bucket ID within the task's existing plan.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_movetask.description: Task to move and destination bucket within its current plan.

id.description: Unchanged task ID after Planner accepted the move.

bucketId.description: Destination bucket ID accepted for the task.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_movetas.description: Task identity and destination bucket after Planner accepted the move.

tags.instructions: Use a task ID from `list-plan-tasks` and a destination bucket ID in its current plan. This does not copy the task or move it between plans. Use `update-task` for non-placement changes. No undo is provided, but moving back to the original bucket may be possible.

functions.name: search-tasks
functions.description: Find one page of tasks matching a search phrase in a group-owned plan.

limit.description: Requested maximum matches per page; default 50.

query.description: Ordinary search phrase interpreted by the provider; matching fields and tokenization follow provider behavior.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this same search; omit for the first page.

planId.description: Opaque plan ID defining the search scope.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_searchta.description: Search phrase, group-owned plan scope, and optional page controls.

id.description: Opaque matching task ID.

dueAt.description: Due instant normalized losslessly to UTC Z; null means unset.

title.description: Task title as ordinary Unicode text, when returned.

planId.description: Containing plan ID, when returned.

bucketId.description: Containing bucket ID, when returned.

priority.description: Priority from 0, highest, to 10, lowest, when returned.

items.description: Assignment user ID.

categoryIds.description: Applied Planner category keys, when returned.

items.description: Applied Planner category key.

percentComplete.description: Completion percentage, when returned; 100 means complete.

items.description: Matching task summary with fields included only when returned.
One provider page of matching tasks in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for identical search options; omitted at exhaustion.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_searcht.description: One page of task search results and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use phrase search when the task ID is unknown. Use `list-plan-tasks` to browse without a phrase and `get-task` after finding an ID. Continue using nextCursor as cursor with identical search options. The default limit is 50; allowed limits are 1–100.

functions.name: update-bucket
functions.description: Partially update a bucket's name or ordering hint without changing its plan or task collection.

name.description: Replacement display name; omit to preserve the current name.

bucketId.description: Opaque identifier of the bucket to modify.

orderHint.description: Opaque replacement Planner ordering hint; omit to preserve position. Null is not a clearing instruction.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_updatebu.description: Identify an existing bucket and supply at least one replacement name or ordering hint.

id.description: Identifier of the bucket whose update was acknowledged.

updated.description: Planner acknowledged the requested partial update.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_updateb.description: Acknowledgement of the requested bucket update, not a post-write bucket snapshot.

tags.instructions: Find bucketId with `list-plan-buckets`. Use this for renaming or ordering an existing bucket, not creation. Omitted properties remain unchanged. A concurrent modification can require reading `get-bucket` and trying again after reviewing the change.

functions.name: update-plan
functions.description: Rename an existing plan without changing its container or child records.

title.description: Replacement title as ordinary text; null and empty titles are not accepted.

planId.description: Opaque identifier of the plan to rename.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_updatepl.description: The existing plan and its replacement title.

id.description: Identifier of the targeted plan.

updated.description: Planner acknowledged the requested title update.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_updatep.description: Acknowledgment of the requested plan title update.

tags.instructions: Use a planId from `list-group-plans` or `get-plan`. This overwrites the title only. Use `create-plan` to create a different plan.

functions.name: update-plan-details
functions.description: Partially update plan category labels and, when permitted, replace the plan's sharedWith user set.

planId.description: Opaque plan ID to modify.

additionalProperties.description: Category label text; null clears the label and empty string explicitly empties it.

categoryLabels.description: Only category labels to change; null clears, empty string explicitly empties, absent keys remain unchanged.

items.description: Opaque user ID to include in the sharedWith set.

sharedWithUserIds.description: Complete replacement of the sharedWith user-ID set, at most 100; [] removes all entries and omission preserves the set.

changes.description: Partial plan-details changes; omitted properties are preserved.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_updatepl.description: Identify the user and plan, and supply the plan-details changes to apply.

planId.description: Opaque plan ID whose details update was accepted.

updated.description: Planner accepted the details update; does not establish complete effective access permissions.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_updatep.description: Acknowledgment that Planner accepted the plan-details update.

tags.instructions: Use `get-plan-details` to inspect labels and sharing information first. Supply only labels to change; null clears a label and empty string is explicit empty text. sharedWithUserIds replaces the complete sharedWith set, so [] removes all such entries. Sharing changes can affect other users and may require plan-owner authority; they are not a substitute for group membership administration.

functions.name: update-task
functions.description: Partially update a task's title, bucket placement, priority, progress, schedule, assignments, categories, or ordering hints without replacing unrelated fields.

planId.description: Identifier of the task's existing plan.

taskId.description: Identifier of the existing task to modify.

dueAt.description: Replacement due instant with explicit offset, or null to clear; preserve up to 12 fractional digits.

title.description: Replacement Unicode title; cannot be null or empty.

startAt.description: Replacement start instant with explicit offset, or null to clear; preserve up to 12 fractional digits.

bucketId.description: Destination bucket identifier within the same plan; changes placement without changing task identity.

priority.description: Replacement exact priority, 0 highest through 10 lowest.

orderHint.description: Provider task-list ordering hint; preserve its exact spaces and case.

assigneeIds.description: Complete desired assignee user ID set; [] removes all assignments.

items.description: User identifier to include in the desired assignee set.

categoryIds.description: Complete desired category set; [] removes all applied categories.

items.description: Category identifier to include in the desired category set.

percentComplete.description: Replacement completion percentage; 100 marks complete and a lower value reopens progress.

assigneePriority.description: Provider assignee-priority ordering hint, preserved exactly.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields stay unchanged, null clears supported nullable schedule fields, and arrays replace complete sets.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_updateta.description: Identify an existing Planner task and supply only the changes to apply.

id.description: Identifier of the modified task.

updated.description: Planner acknowledged the requested update; not a guarantee against later concurrent changes.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_updatet.description: Acknowledgment of a successful Planner task update.

tags.instructions: Get task and plan IDs from `list-plan-tasks`. Supply only changes; omitted fields remain unchanged. Moving to a bucket is limited to the same plan. Assignment and category arrays replace those sets, so read `get-task` first if you need to retain current members. Use `update-task-details` for description, checklist, and references.

functions.name: update-task-assigned-to-board-format
functions.description: Partially modify the fallback and per-assignee ordering of a task in the assigned-to board view without changing task assignments.

taskId.description: Opaque parent task ID.

assigneeOrderHints.description: Complete desired per-user ordering hints, up to 100 entries; [] removes all explicit hints. User IDs must be unique.

userId.description: Opaque user ID for the board ordering entry; this does not assign the task to that user.

orderHint.description: Exact Planner ordering hint for this user's assigned-to board view; significant spaces are preserved.

items.description: A desired per-user board ordering entry.

unassignedOrderHint.description: Exact fallback hint for unassigned or otherwise unspecified users; null requests clearing, omission preserves it.

changes.description: Partial format changes; omitted fields are preserved and supplied per-user hints replace that set.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_updateta.description: Task ID and partial assigned-to board format changes.

taskId.description: Task whose assigned-to view format was modified.

updated.description: Planner accepted the format changes; no assignment or numerical rank guarantee is implied.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_updatet.description: Confirmation that Planner accepted the assigned-to board format update.

tags.instructions: Get task IDs from `list-plan-tasks` and inspect formatting with `get-task-assigned-to-board-format`. Supplied assigneeOrderHints is the complete desired per-user hint set; [] removes it so the fallback applies. Omission preserves that set. Use `update-task` to assign or unassign users.

functions.name: update-task-bucket-board-format
functions.description: Modify the ordering format of one task in the bucket-grouped task board without moving it to another bucket.

taskId.description: Opaque parent task ID.

orderHint.description: Exact Planner bucket-view ordering hint; null requests clearing. Its characters and spaces are significant.

FunctionInput_microsoft_planner_updateta.description: Task and replacement bucket-board ordering hint, or null to request clearing.

taskId.description: Task whose bucket board format was modified.

updated.description: Planner accepted the format update; not an assertion of a numerical rank.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_planner_updatet.description: Confirmation that Planner accepted the task bucket-board format update.

tags.instructions: Get task IDs from `list-plan-tasks` and inspect existing hints with `get-task-bucket-board-format`. Use this for specialist exact Planner ordering-hint control. Use `move-task` to change bucket membership. Omitted changes are not supported: supply the intended replacement hint or null to clear it.

functions.name: update-task-details

planId.description: Opaque containing plan ID.

taskId.description: Opaque task ID.

id.description: Existing checklist key to edit/remove or caller-chosen new unique key to create.

title.description: Checklist text; empty string is forwarded for provider validation.

orderHint.description: Exact optional advanced Planner checklist-order hint.

functions.description: Modify a task's ordering format in the progress-grouped task board without changing completion.

taskId.description: Opaque parent task ID.
